entities.name: Table T1 – Equity flows: Energy sector cumulative flows 2017-2024
entities.brief: Cumulative ETF and single stock flows for Energy
entities.description: Shows divergence between ETF and single stock cumulative flows in Energy sector from 2017 to late 2024

properties.key_insight: ETF cumulative flows peaked at ~$6,000mn in mid-2021 then declined to ~$4,000mn by late 2024, while single stock flows trough at -$8,000mn in early 2022 and recovered to -$5,000mn by late 2024.

entities.description: Lowest cumulative single stock flow of Energy sector around early 2022

entities.name: Table T2 – Equity flows: Financials sector cumulative flows 2016-2024
entities.brief: Cumulative ETF and single stock flows for Financials
entities.description: Shows divergence with strong single stock inflows versus flat-to-negative ETF flows in Financials sector from 2016 to 2024

properties.key_insight: Single stock flows in Financials rose steadily to ~$50,000mn by 2024, while ETF flows remained near zero and turned slightly negative by end-2024.
